### Quiet Walk - Jan. 20
Author: Walk Thru the Bible
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/quiet-walk/quiet-walk-jan-20-1126348.html
Passage: Genesis 41:16
Points:
- Believers are called to faithful obedience, while the results belong entirely to God.
- Confusing human responsibility with divine outcomes leads to anxiety or arrogance.
- Joseph modeled true humility before Pharaoh by attributing all insight and interpretation to God.
- Distinguishing our calling from God's sovereign work allows us to serve with peace and freedom.
